run_train_text_to_image_flax: run the Flax-based text-to-image Stable Diffusion training script with pretrained model and dataset
parse_train_text_to_image_args: parse command-line arguments for Flax text-to-image training including dataset, batch size, and learning rate
train_flax_stable_diffusion_unet: train the Flax UNet2DConditionModel with DDPMScheduler noise prediction on image-caption dataset
save_flax_stable_diffusion_pipeline: save the trained Flax Stable Diffusion pipeline with unet, vae, text encoder, and safety checker params
preprocess_flax_image_dataset: preprocess image dataset with tokenized captions, resized crops, and normalized pixel values for Flax training
